name: superisland-window-hint-expanded-layout
title: 增加window hint新形态，独立于当前的window hint或superisland（复制superisland或通过组件设置实现：window hint展开后，bar区域内superisland本体自适应拓宽其背景，以容纳工作区中所有title胶囊（宽度为独占宽度，暂时挤占其他组件使其离开原位或屏幕），将目前window hint的title所在行改为bar区域内superisland拓宽的区域内；原window hint工作区概览胶囊和window hint背景本体位置不变；可显示时钟和通知的superisland本体移动到工作区底部
description: Plan a new window hint presentation that expands a SuperIsland-like body within the bar to host all title capsules while preserving the existing lower window hint workspace overview lane and relocating the regular clock/notification SuperIsland body below the workspace area.
creator: Sighthesia
